name: Stomp Ground
text:
You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes. Each creature in a 5-foot emanation must attempt a Reflex save saving throw against your class DC.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Off-Guard until the end of your turn.

Failure The creature is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage from the fall.
